language.title: Language
language.hint: Match system uses your computer's language when Buun Mail speaks it.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: Match system follows your computer between light and dark.

density.title: Message list
density.hint: Compact fits more messages on screen.

grain.title: Paper grain
grain.hint: A fine paper texture over the window.

workspaces.introDefault: Workspaces live in your routing file, <file/>. Add, change or delete them here, or right-click one in the sidebar. Its icon or image is kept on this computer and wins over the file's <field/>.
workspaces.introAt: Workspaces live in your routing file at <file/>. Add, change or delete them here, or right-click one in the sidebar. Its icon or image is kept on this computer and wins over the file's <field/>.
workspaces.name: Name
workspaces.addressesHint: One a line. *@example.com takes every address at a domain; an exact address wins over its domain in another workspace.
workspaces.foldersHint: Mail from a sender lands in its folder, first match wins. Everything else stays in the inbox.
workspaces.deleteBody: It leaves your routing file. Its mail stays: each message moves to the workspace that now claims its address, or to Unsorted.
workspaces.imageUnreadable: That image could not be read.
workspaces.imageTooBig: That image is over {{megabytes}} MB. Pick a smaller one.

readingPane.title: Reading pane
readingPane.hint: Off lets the list fill the window; opening a message shows it in full, with Back to the list.

updates.title: Check for updates
updates.hint: Once a day, asks the Buun Mail releases page on GitHub for the newest version and tells you when one is out. Nothing about you or your mail is sent.
updates.channelStableHint: Stable releases only: tested, and the same for everyone.
updates.channelEarlyHint: Betas too, as soon as they are built: new features first, and sometimes rough edges.
updates.newer: Buun Mail {{latest}} is out. You have {{current}}.
updates.promptDetail: You have {{current}}. Install it now, or later from Settings, General.

remember.title: Reopen where I left off
remember.hint: Opens on the folder and message you had open when Buun Mail closed, instead of the first inbox.

conversations.title: Group by conversation
conversations.hint: One row per conversation, showing its newest message, with replies and your sent answers gathered above the open message.

senderChecks.title: Sender checks and size in the list
senderChecks.hint: SPF, DKIM and DMARC for each message, as the receiving server found them, and its size. Point at one to see what it means.

security.sealedHint: Every API key, token and password Buun Mail keeps is encrypted on this computer with a key made for this install (vault.key in the config folder, readable only by you). Updates keep the key, so nothing needs entering again.
security.codeHint: Set a code to be asked before a saved key, token or password is shown again. Mail and alerts keep working without it.
security.codeSetHint: A code is set. It is asked before a saved secret is shown, then not again for five minutes.
security.mismatch: The two codes are not the same.
security.passkeyLater: Unlocking with a passkey, Touch ID or Windows Hello is planned; it depends on what each system offers.

profile.fromAny: The first address that can send
profile.fromNone: Connect a sender for this workspace's domain to pick its address here.
profile.signatureHint: Used on this workspace's mail in place of the sender's own signature. Leave empty to keep that one.

backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Your whole mailbox and every setting, connections included, in one file sealed with a passphrase. Keep it somewhere safe, or use it to move Buun Mail to another computer.
backup.keepIt: Without the passphrase the backup cannot be opened by anyone, you included. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup.tooShort: Use a passphrase of at least {{count}} characters.
backup.mismatch: The two passphrases are not the same.
backup.stagedDetail_one: {{count}} file ready. Restart Buun Mail to finish.
backup.stagedDetail_other: {{count}} files ready. Restart Buun Mail to finish.
backup.restart: Quit and reopen Buun Mail to finish the restore. What it replaces is kept in a before-restore folder beside your mail.
